summary: Metal frame of a former fire tower on Cohutta Mountain in Fort Mountain State Park, with the cab missing; NHLR-registered 2021. Build date and history not found.

facts.design: Metal tower frame; the cab is missing
facts.status_note: Only the metal frame remains. The cab is missing, per the Register.

access.note: On Fort Mountain State Park land. No source says whether the frame is open to visitors, and the cab is gone.

events.note: Registered January 8, 2021 as US 1479, GA 29; nominated by Patrick H. Warren, MPH

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Register is the only source with detail on this frame. Build date, builder, staffing and fire history were not found in any source read. The Freedman article names no replacement steel tower, so any link to this frame is unproven. The brief's status 'standing' is kept but qualified by status_note. Patrick H. Warren is the Register nominator, named as recorded. A Georgia DNR or Fort Mountain State Park enquiry is the best next step for the history.
